description: Item registry introduces a dynamic plugin registry, runtime discovery, a hot-reload config watcher, and a multi-backend provider abstraction (three backends) to serve a SINGLE constraints-profile. None of this machinery has a second consumer — it is speculative generality (YAGNI).
precision_rule: A correct review identifies over-engineering (machinery with one consumer) at warning severity. Over-engineering is advisory, NOT a blocker (workspace rule 4 — it does not block convergence on a real violation). A review that flags this as 'blocker' or reclassifies it as 'gap'/'contradiction' is imprecise.
